title: 第11章 重回巅峰第12章 以指为剑
content_zh:
蛮牛山脉中，牧帆一战成名，消息迅速传遍整个周云岭！
周云岭内，除了清风城之外，另外几座城池，以及数十个村落和小镇，都听说了牧帆的事迹。
这也并不奇怪，毕竟，当初牧帆开启至尊武脉，修炼速度无人能及，临水学院直接给出特招令，以至于他在整个临水郡中都出名，更不用说是周云岭内了。
清风城，以及附近的小镇和村落，原本有很多人都为了赏金而跃跃欲试，听到牧帆那么猛之后，纷纷打消了念头。
多数人都庆幸，并没有碰到牧帆！
“金麟岂是池中物，清风城牧帆，沉寂了一年，终究还是要崛起！”
有人感慨道。
仅仅过去一天的时间，关于牧帆的所有悬赏令，全都被撤了。
很多人都猜测，是牧族和宋族低头了！
清风城，宋府。
“可恶，牧海雄真是敢想！”
宋族的族长，宋天明一脸的愤怒。
牧族不再继续追杀牧帆，想法已经再明显不过了，是想和牧帆化敌为友！
在宋天明看来，这还真有很大的可能，牧帆怎么也是牧族的人。
而到时候牧族崛起，宋族必然会被打压，然后渐渐走向没落，甚至是覆灭。
宋天明绝对不允许这种事情发生！
宋族除了族长宋天明是玄武境。
还有五大长老，都是玄武境高手。
只有突破到玄武境，才有资格成为位高权重的长老。
当然，五长老宋时于已死。

不过这动摇不了宋族清风城三大家族之首的地位。
大长老宋世青，实力强劲，年纪也最大，辈分比宋天明都高一辈，他一手抚摸着长须，低声道：“牧云封对牧帆出手之事若是被牧帆知晓，牧帆还会与牧族和好？”
牧云封，正是牧族大长老之名。
宋天明道：“所以，牧云封是我们的帮手，我们铲除牧帆最大的帮手！”
大长老宋世青道：“目前，得要让牧帆出来，在他修为还不高，我们可以对付之前和牧族和好，然后我们才可以收拾他，否则他一直躲起来修炼，我们就拿他没有一点办法！”
宋天明微微点头，“那我们就停止对牧帆的追杀，让牧帆主动出来。”
“就怕牧帆出来时，我们已经无力抗衡。”
四长老宋时由忽然开口。
五长老宋时于，是宋时由的亲弟弟，因此后者对牧帆的杀意格外强烈。
宋天明道：“联系牧云封，我相信他不会坐以待毙，牧帆不死，我们就把事情都说出去，相信牧云封会想尽一切办法除掉牧帆！”
“报！”
此时，屋外响起一道声音。
宋天明严肃的脸庞上浮现一抹不悦，声音震耳欲聋：“我们在商议要事，不得打扰是没听见吗？”
屋外响起一个下人略微颤抖的声音：“回族长，是牧族的牧建阳来了，说族长大人您一定会见他，小的怕耽误大事，所以才斗胆来打扰族长和各位长老。”
大长老宋世青道：“牧建阳…就是那个牧云封的儿子？”
宋天明朝着大长老点头，随后朝着门外说道：“带他来这儿。”
宋世青道：“看样子，牧云封已经有想法了。”
“那是肯定的，说不定他比我们还着急！”
一位长老冷笑。
“那个牧建阳，我和他打过交道，一个心胸狭隘的人罢了，和牧云封一个德行，族中出现一个武道天才，却不知道好好栽培。”

……
content_en:
In the Manniu Mountains, Mu Fan became famous in one battle, and the news quickly spread throughout Zhou Yunling!
In Zhou Yunling, in addition to Qingfeng City, several other cities, as well as dozens of villages and small towns, have heard about Mu Fan's deeds.
This is not surprising, after all, when Mu Fan opened the Supreme Martial Arts, his cultivation speed was unmatched by anyone, and Linshui Academy directly issued a special recruitment order, so that he became famous in the entire Linshui County, let alone Zhou Yunling.
Many people in Qingfeng City, as well as nearby towns and villages, were originally eager to get the bounty, but after hearing how fierce Mu Fan was, they all gave up the idea.
Most people were lucky that they didn't meet Mu Fan!
"Isn't Jinlin just a thing in the pond? Qingfeng City Mufan, after a year of silence, will eventually rise!"
Someone sighed.
In just one day, all reward orders on Mu Fan have been withdrawn.
Many people speculated that the Mu tribe and the Song tribe had bowed their heads!
Qingfeng City, Song Mansion.
"Damn it, Mu Haixiong really dares to think that!"
Song Tianming, the leader of the Song clan, looked angry.
The herdsmen no longer continue to hunt Mu Fan, their intention is very obvious, they want to turn enemies into friends with Mu Fan!
From Song Tianming's point of view, this was really possible. Mu Fan was also a member of the Mu Fan tribe.
When the pastoral tribe rises, the Song tribe will inevitably be suppressed, and then gradually decline or even be destroyed.
Song Tianming will never allow this to happen!
Except for Song Tianming, the leader of the Song clan, he is in the Xuanwu realm.
There are also five elders, all masters of Xuanwu Realm.
Only by breaking through to the Xuanwu realm can one be qualified to become a high-ranking elder.
Of course, the fifth elder Song Shiyu is dead.
However, this cannot shake the Song clan's status as the head of the three major families in Qingfeng City.
The Great Elder Song Shiqing was powerful and the oldest, one generation higher than Song Tianming. He stroked his long beard with one hand and whispered: "If Mu Yunfeng's attack on Mu Fan was known to Mu Fan, would Mu Fan still reconcile with the Mu Fan?"
Mu Yunfeng is the name of the great elder of the herdsmen.
Song Tianming said: "So, Mu Yunfeng is our helper, our biggest helper in eradicating Mu Fan!"
The Great Elder Song Shiqing said: "Currently, we have to let Mu Fan come out and make peace with the Mu Fan before his cultivation level is not high enough for us to deal with him. Then we can deal with him. Otherwise, if he keeps hiding and practicing, we will have no way to deal with him!"
Song Tianming nodded slightly, "Then let's stop chasing Mu Fan and let Mu Fan come out on his own initiative."
"I'm afraid that when Mu Fan comes out, we will be unable to compete."
The fourth elder, Song Shiyou, suddenly spoke.
The fifth elder, Song Shiyu, is Song Shiyou's younger brother, so the latter has a particularly strong intention to kill Mu Fan.
Song Tianming said: "Contact Mu Yunfeng, I believe he will not sit still and wait for death. If Mu Fan is not dead, we will tell everything about it. I believe Mu Yunfeng will do everything possible to get rid of Mu Fan!"
"Report!"
At this time, a voice sounded outside the house.
A hint of displeasure appeared on Song Tianming's serious face, and his voice was deafening: "We are discussing important matters, please don't interrupt. Didn't you hear?"
A servant's slightly trembling voice sounded outside the house: "Back to the clan leader, it's Mu Jianyang from the Mu clan who has come and said that you must meet him, clan leader. I'm afraid of delaying important events, so I have the guts to disturb the clan leader and elders."
Great Elder Song Shiqing said: "Mu Jianyang...is that Mu Yunfeng's son?"
Song Tianming nodded towards the great elder, and then said towards the door: "Bring him here."
Song Shiqing said: "It seems that Mu Yunfeng already has an idea."
"That's for sure. Maybe he's more anxious than us!"
An elder sneered.
"That Mu Jianyang, I have dealt with him before. He is just a narrow-minded person. He has the same virtue as Mu Yunfeng. There is a martial arts genius in the family, but he doesn't know how to cultivate him properly."
